test.name: Persist the same_person score on a record_search-sourced link
test.description: Link assertion a_001 — the clean 1850-census Patrick Flynn persona (record_persona_id P1) — to a person in the tree. Because a_001 is record_search-sourced, person-evidence resolves the record from its sidecar, builds a tree subset, and calls same_person. The returned score must be persisted to the new person_evidence entry's match_score.
